title: New Cross Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency health facilities, hazard zones, and essential supply points for New Cross.
content: For life-threatening emergencies, call 999 immediately. 1. Nearest Hospitals with 24-Hour A&E: - University Hospital Lewisham (Lewisham High Street, London SE13 6LH). Directions from New Cross Gate Station: ~25 min walk south-east along A20 Lewisham Way and Lewisham High Street (1.4 miles), or take bus 21, 136, or 436 south. - King's College Hospital (Denmark Hill, London SE5 9RS) — Designated Major Trauma Centre. Directions from New Cross Station: ~35 min walk west via Queen's Road and Peckham High Street (2.1 miles), or take London Overground train to Denmark Hill, or bus 36 or 436 west. 2. NHS Urgent Treatment Centres: - Lewisham Urgent Treatment Centre (Lewisham High Street, London SE13 6LH). Handles minor fractures, urgent cuts, infections, and sprains. Follow travel directions for Lewisham Hospital above. - Guy's Urgent Care Centre (Great Maze Pond, London SE1 9RT). Directions from New Cross Station: ~10 min mainline train directly to London Bridge, or ~35 min walk north-west along Old Kent Road/Borough High Street. 3. Local Hazard Notes: Heavy surface water runoff frequently collects at the low railway bridge dips on New Cross Road (A2) and Lewisham Way (A20) during flash downpours, causing impassable road corridors for pedestrians and small vehicles. 4. Essential Supplies: Pharmacies and retail supermarkets along New Cross Road and Lewisham Way provide emergency water bottles, sanitation items, and over-the-counter medicine. Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
